findings.title: Refunded terminated grant retains a nonzero balance
findings.summary: On the exact merged and live release, the original terminated grant wallet displays its existing successful USD -1 refund alongside USD +1 contribution, with current and available balance zero. The refund remains visible after full reload and reopening Wallet. Missing historical running balances are explicitly unavailable. Actual Chrome readback and visual review passed at all six measured CSS viewports.
steps: Sign in normally as the controlled Pitcher using the Pitcher Chrome profile on the deployed app.
Open the original controlled PIT035 terminated grant and its Wallet; reveal its balance.
Verify the existing refund debit USD -1, contribution USD +1 and current/available balance zero. No new transaction is submitted.
Read and visually inspect the refund row at all six measured CSS viewport dimensions.
Reload the deployed app and reopen Wallet; verify the existing refund and zero balance persist.
